Triage: `pm:queue` (was `finding`), `domain:devx`, type Task — cross-domain rider designated.

Rationale: the sync obligation lives in the `invoked-as` gate family (`scripts/**` ⇒ devx); the fix is reciprocal back-pointers so the three-copy obligation is discoverable from all three ends. One of the two target files is `packages/cli/src/utils/invocation.ts` (cli territory): comment-only, one line — designated by triage to ride the devx PR rather than split; declare the two-file surface in the claim. S, mechanical; sonnet-eligible.

Constraint: pointers only — both objectstack copies are measured correct in substance; do not "fix" their prose. objectui's copy already names all three ends (objectui PR #6260) — verify its final wording on the merged ref and mirror it.

So the premise holds unchanged: neither objectstack copy is discoverable from the objectui end.

**Serial constraints.** No hot-file collision at claim time. `scripts/invoked-as.mjs` is not in this seat's serial queue. ⚠️ One adjacency to watch, not a block: #11904 (`pm:queue`, undispatched) concerns six `scripts/**` docblocks carrying the over-broad #9465 fence reading — if `scripts/invoked-as.mjs` turns out to be one of the six, that is a **different edit to the same docblock**. It is serial behind PR #12030 either way, so this card goes first; #11904's dev will rebase.

**Fold-or-serial:** not folded with #11920 (dispatched in the same batch). Gate ① fails — different defect shape (a missing cross-repo back-pointer vs. an absent self-test instrument), different fix, disjoint file surfaces. They run in parallel.

**Cross-repo note.** Triage directs mirroring objectui's final wording from PR #6260. That is a **read** of the objectui tree to copy a sentence; the landing repo is objectstack and every edit is in objectstack. ⛔ No objectui file is touched by this card, and no objectui card is claimed by this seat.

## ACCEPT (on the work) — PR #12084 · ⛔ landing HELD until CI converges

Reviewer of record: devx seat, `session_01UjM2ia8Av1v5NqfqQEQmC6` (seat #6023).

⏳ **Not flipping ready yet.** 0 failures, but `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Build Core`, three `Dogfood` legs and two `Test Core` shards are still `in_progress`. Same discipline applied to #12080 this round.

### ⭐ The changeset call came out against my leaning, and it was *derived* rather than argued

I flagged this as genuinely open and asked for a derivation, not my guess. My leaning was `skip-changeset` — nothing observable to a consumer moves. **That was wrong**, and the dev showed why with three readings instead of an opinion:

1. **objectstack has no per-file changeset path analysis.** `check-empty-changeset.mjs` and `pr-automation.yml`'s "Require a changeset" step make a binary author-judgment call; `check:changeset-gate-self-tests` only pins the checkers' own fixtures. (objectui has `check-changeset-presence.mjs` for this; objectstack has no equivalent — so the mechanism I was implicitly reasoning from does not exist here.)
2. **The operative rule is the lane doc's own text**, tied to file *location*, not content: 落进已发布包的源 ⇒ 真 changeset. `packages/cli` is published — I confirmed `"name": "@objectstack/cli"`, `"version": "17.2.0"`, no `"private"` — and the edit lands in its `src/`.
3. **The precedent, which I verified myself rather than accepting the citation.** `.changeset/cli-readme-drop-os-studio.md` exists on `origin/main` and is exactly as described: a `patch` changeset for a **pure prose correction to a README** — not even compiled source. (Positive control: 179 changesets in the directory, so the lookup works.) This repo's convention treats "lands in a published package" as sufficient regardless of whether behaviour changes.

⇒ Real changeset (`@objectstack/cli`: patch), not the label. The dev also named the residual honestly: `scripts/invoked-as.mjs` alone would qualify for `skip-changeset`, but the rule has no per-file carve-out at PR granularity, so the `packages/cli` edit governs the whole PR.

### The cross-repo constraint was honoured exactly

objectui PR #6260 was verified **merged** (`ef2a3bd8d`, 2026-08-25T05:20:54Z) and its final wording read directly off `objectui:main` — not from this card's quotation of it, which is what Zone 2 asked for. Read-only: no objectui file touched, branched, or opened. That is the correct reading of the maintainer's territory ruling — the landing repo is objectstack, and reading a sibling tree to copy a sentence is a read, not a claim.

### It applied the sanitizer lesson unprompted

The PR body spells one placeholder **in words**, with the reason stated inline: *"GitHub's body sanitizer strips a literal angle-bracket fragment even inside a code span."* That is the rule this seat adopted mid-shift after damaging its own evidence twice, arrived at independently here.

### Scope held
Comment-only in both files; neither file's existing prose corrected, per the triage constraint — both were already accurate for this tree. 28 additions, 3 deletions across 3 files (two source, one changeset). `scripts/invoked-as.mjs --self-test` still 11 cases, `check:entry-guard` still 157 files / 113 bindings / 111 inert — the docblock-only assumption confirmed by measurement rather than assumed.

23 gate families derived in the dev's **own** worktree (not the shared checkout), reproducing my 17 pre-changeset + 6 changeset-triggered lists exactly, all green. One declared prerequisite unrelated to the diff: `check:i18n-coverage` needed a dependency build first because of a stale `dist/` in a fresh worktree — declared as not-a-defect rather than silently worked around.

**Next step:** flip ready, arm SQUASH, verify by the queue ref, once every named gate job reports `completed` green.
